title: M1.3：C01、C02、R2-C10 三條候選的初篩（文獻、critic、證明嘗試）

C01.proof: odd n proven in Lean; even n proven in Lean for v2(n) <= 10, on paper for v2(n) <= 22 and whenever 2^(v2(n)+1)-1 is not abundant; open for v2(n)+1 in {24,36,40,48,60,...}

C02.proof: complete paper proof incl. full characterization H2' (checked by critic, proof agent and reviewer); Lean only partial (c02b, odd_prime_factor_unique)

R2-C10.proof: no general proof; Lean decide check 6 <= w <= 200; three implementations to w = 300; independent simulations to w = 1200

sources_checked: oeis online via claude-in-chrome (6 queries, literature.md)
novelty.note: no match within the queries made; not evidence of novelty. arXiv/MathSciNet not checked. The A065301 structure formula (squarefree, primes in A049097, p+1 pairwise coprime) is already in OEIS (Eldar 2025); only the rad/sigma solution set and its 2^a*p part were not found.
